title: Communicating spaces.
officialText:
Where an evaporator or condenser is located in an air duct system, the volume of the
smallest, enclosed occupied space served by the duct system shall be used to determine the maximum allowable quantity of
refrigerant in the system.
Exception: If airflow to any enclosed space cannot be reduced below one-quarter of its maximum, the entire space served by
the air duct system shall be used to determine the maximum allowable quantity of refrigerant in the system.
